description: This file defines a Python class 'SuggestionRepository' that handles database CRUD operations related to suggestions within a project. It extends a base repository class and provides methods to create a new suggestion and to list suggestions by analysis ID.

classes.name: SuggestionRepository
classes.description: A class that provides CRUD operations for 'suggestions' in the database, such as creating a suggestion and listing suggestions by analysis ID.

methods.name: int create(self, analysis_id: int, title: str, message: str, priority: str)
methods.description: Asynchronously inserts a new suggestion into the database with given parameters and returns the suggestion ID.

methods.name: List[dict] list_by_analysis(self, analysis_id: int)
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves all suggestions associated with a specific analysis ID, ordered by creation date.
